location: prop:setting:align (b) and (c), and the proof of (b): "By \cref{lem:setting:preservation}, $\rho_d(\mathrm{par}(T))\subseteq\mathrm{par}(d)$"
problem: (b) and the last clause of (c) are false for C=DT°_F and for C=DT°. The minimality clause of (c) is also false for DT°. The proof step is invalid: the preservation lemma covers only skeleton positions. A parameter that occurs only in an argument of a non-pattern occurrence disappears from every datum whose value does not use that hole, so G need not be a subset of par(r). Counterexamples, computed with dtrc (scratch/align_cex.py and align_cex2.py): (1) DT°_F. Take D={0=0∧(∀x 0=0 ∧ 0=0), 0=0∧(∀x x=x ∧ w0=w0), w0=w0∧(∀x x=0 ∧ w1=0)}. Then T=Q∧(∀xP(x)∧P(c)) covers D, there is a single alignment, Min^al(D)={f0=f0∧(∀xP0(x)∧f1=f2)}, and T is not ⪰~ that member. The same happens with T*=(Q∨¬Q)∧(∀xP(x)→P(c)), all of whose instances are valid; this also breaks experiments prop:exp:oracle(b). (2) DT°. Take D'={∀x(0=0)∧0=0, ∀x(x=x)∧w0=w0, ∀x(x=0)∧w0=0}. Then Min^al(D')={∀x(f0(x)=f1(x))∧f2=f1(u)}. This member is strictly above T=∀x(g(x)=h(x))∧g(c)=h(c), which covers D', and T is above no member. The same gap is in the record's proof of experiments Prop E1-al.
fix: Replace (b) and (c) by: "(b) Every $T\in\mathcal C$ that covers $D$ up to renaming and all of whose parameters occur in $\mathrm{skel}(T)$ satisfies $T\gen^{\sim}M$ for some member $M$. (c) $\Min^{\mathrm{al}}_{\mathcal C}(D)$ is finite; no template as in (b) lies strictly below a member; and if $D\subseteq\inst^{\sim}(T^*)$ with $T^*\in\mathcal C$ and every parameter of $T^*$ in $\mathrm{skel}(T^*)$ (in particular if $T^*$ is parameter-free), some member $M$ satisfies $T^*\gen^{\sim}M$." In the proof of (b), write "Every parameter of $T$ lies in $\mathrm{skel}(T)$, so by \cref{lem:setting:preservation} $\rho_d(\mathrm{par}(T))\subseteq\mathrm{par}(d)$." In the proof of (c), write "If some $T$ as in (b) satisfied ...". Add a remark giving counterexample (1) and saying that a parameter occurring only inside an argument of a non-pattern occurrence need not occur in the reference datum. Note that the record's E1-al carries the same restriction, and that experiments.tex:44 and prop:exp:oracle(b) inherit it. Alternative: define alignments as partial injective identifications across all data, not anchored at r. This makes (b) true in general but needs a code change.

location: l.111: "If some datum has no parameter there is one alignment, and $\Min^{\mathrm{al}}_{\mathcal C}(D)$ is $\Min_{\mathcal C}(D)$ up to $\equiv^{\sim}$."
problem: False. The single alignment (G=∅) renames every parameter apart, so Min^al(D)=Min(α(D)), and this can differ from the literal Min(D). For D={∀x(0=0)∧0=0, ∀x(x=x)∧w0=w0, ∀x(x=0)∧w0=0} in DT°_F, the literal Min(D) is {∀xP0(x)∧f0=f1, ∀xP0(x)∧P0(w0)}, while Min(α(D)) is {∀xP0(x)∧f0=f1} (computed). The writer's justification overlooks parameters in derived arguments. The definition also does not match the code: AlignedMinCover.minimal() returns the literal MinCover(D) when there is at most one alignment. app-experiments' proof of prop:exp:numerals cites this sentence; it is still fine there only because those data are parameter-free.
fix: Replace with: "If some datum has no parameter there is exactly one alignment ($G=\emptyset$); it renames all parameters apart, so no member has a parameter in its skeleton. It can differ from the literal $\Min_{\mathcal C}(D)$ of the canonicalized data: for $D=\{\forall x(0{=}0)\wedge0{=}0,\ \forall x(x{=}x)\wedge w_0{=}w_0,\ \forall x(x{=}0)\wedge w_0{=}0\}$ the literal set also contains $\forall xP(x)\wedge P(w_0)$. (The implementation uses the literal set in this case.)"

location: l.106, preorder parenthetical: "and $\rho'\rho$ is injective on $\mathrm{par}(T)$ because $\mathrm{par}(T')\supseteq\rho(\mathrm{par}(T))$ by \cref{lem:setting:preservation}"
problem: The intermediate claim is false. With T=∀xP(x)∧P(a)∧b=b and σ(P)=λz.R, the parameter a vanishes from T', and ρ': b↦a is allowed, so ρ'ρ need not be injective on par(T). The conclusion (⪰~ is a preorder) still holds.
fix: Replace with: "after changing $\rho'$, on the parameters of $\rho T$ that do not occur in $T'$, to fresh distinct names (such parameters occur only inside arguments whose holes $\sigma$ discards, so $T''$ is unchanged), $\rho'\rho$ is injective on $\mathrm{par}(T)$".

location: proof of prop:setting:align(a) (l.132): "The rigid parameters of $M$ occur in ... So $\alpha_d^{-1}$ is injective on $\mathrm{par}(M)$"
problem: A member M can have parameters inside derived arguments that do not occur in α_d(d); the DT° member in the align counterexample has one. On these α_d^{-1} is undefined, so the step does not apply. The conclusion is still true.
fix: "Extend $\alpha_d^{-1}$ injectively to $\mathrm{par}(M)$ by sending the parameters of $M$ that do not occur in $\alpha_d(d)$ to fresh distinct names; they occur in $M$ only inside arguments that $\theta_d$ discards. Then $d=(\alpha_d^{-1}M)(\alpha_d^{-1}\theta_d)$."
